summary: Three unprepared hikers stranded in deep snow near the High Lonesome Trail at about 11,600 feet; Grand County Search and Rescue paged at 5:01 p.m. and reached the group via ATVs up Rollins Pass Road then on foot; the hikers were cold and tired with no fire-starting gear, and rescuers hiked them out overnight, all out of the field by 4:18 a.m. November 15
location: High Lonesome Trail near Rollins Pass
notes: Freshness sweep 2026-11-20: SnowBrains 2026-11-19 + Grand County Search and Rescue Facebook post 2026-11-19, both parent-opened live; paged Sat Nov 14 5:01 p.m., out Sun Nov 15 4:18 a.m.; hikers' names/ages unreported; camp at ~11,600 ft in the Indian Peaks Wilderness.
